title: B2.1 Unit 2 quiz — Presentations
description: Marcadores de discurso, tendências e gráficos, números aproximados, future perfect, perguntas do público, graphic e adequate.

questions.question: Complete: "I'd like to start by ___ at last year's results."
Que frase introduz a parte mais importante de uma apresentação?

options.text: This brings me to the most important part.

questions.explanation: This brings me to… anuncia algo importante.

questions.question: Prices went from 200 to 220. Complete: "Prices rose ___ ten percent."
questions.explanation: by = a diferença; to = o número final.

questions.question: Escolha a frase correcta.

options.text: There was a sharp fall in December.
There was a sharply fall in December.

questions.explanation: Adjectivo + nome (a sharp fall); verbo + advérbio (fell sharply).

questions.question: "Até Junho (o mais tardar), teremos instalado as antenas." Em inglês:

options.text: By June, we will have installed the antennas.
Until June, we will have installed the antennas.
By June, we will installed the antennas.

questions.explanation: Future perfect: will have + particípio, com by.

questions.question: Complete: "By the time the plant ___, we'll have tested the network."
questions.explanation: Depois de by the time: presente.

questions.question: Não sabe um número que lhe perguntam. A melhor resposta é…

options.text: I'm afraid I don't have that figure with me. I'll get back to you on that by Friday.
Er… maybe two thousand? Or three?

questions.question: "Vou dar-lhe uma resposta sobre isso até sexta." Em inglês:

options.text: I'll get back to you on that by Friday.
I'll return you the answer until Friday.
I'll give you a feedback until Friday.

questions.explanation: get back to someone on something.

questions.question: "O gráfico mostra as vendas." Em inglês:
questions.explanation: Falso amigo: graphic = visual, de design.

questions.question: Reciclagem (B2, unidade 1). Escolha a frase correcta.

options.text: Celeste, who is a lawyer, chairs the board.
Celeste, that is a lawyer, chairs the board.
Celeste who is a lawyer, chairs the board.

questions.question: Reciclagem (B1, unidade 10). "Ele devia ter dito que não sabia." Em inglês:

options.text: He should have said he didn't know.
He should said he didn't know.
He must have say he didn't know.
